scripts.android:release: ng build --configuration production && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:sync: ng build --configuration development && CAP_ENV=development cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && CAPACITOR_ANDROID_STUDIO_PATH=${CAPACITOR_ANDROID_STUDIO_PATH:-/snap/android-studio/current/bin/studio.sh} cap open android
scripts.install_app: ng build --configuration development && CAP_ENV=development cap sync android && CAP_ENV=development ionic capacitor run android --no-build
scripts.install_app:prod: ng build --configuration production && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew installDebug

scripts-info.ng: Angular CLI passthrough: npm run ng -- <command>.
scripts-info.start: Serves the app in the browser with live reload (development configuration).
scripts-info.build: Production build into www/. It uses environment.prod.ts, so do not use it for device builds.
scripts-info.watch: Rebuilds www/ on every change using the development configuration.
scripts-info.test: Unused: this project does not implement unit tests.
scripts-info.android:add: Creates the android/ project. Only needed when the folder does not exist; never delete and re-add it, it holds manual changes (microphone permission, speech queries, cleartext).
scripts-info.android:release: Production build (apiUrl https://iabarber.onrender.com), sync without cleartext and signed release APK in android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/.
scripts-info.android:sync: Development build (apiUrl http://localhost:3000) and copy of www/ into android/. Run it after every front-end change, then press Run in Android Studio.
scripts-info.android:open: Runs android:sync and opens the android/ project in Android Studio (snap path by default; override with CAPACITOR_ANDROID_STUDIO_PATH).
scripts-info.install_app: Development build, sync and install on the USB phone without Android Studio (--no-build stops Ionic from rebuilding in production). Needs adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 and the backend running.
scripts-info.install_app:prod: Production build (apiUrl https://iabarber.onrender.com), sync without cleartext and install on the USB phone. Needs neither the local backend nor adb reverse.
scripts-info.version:bump: Bumps the patch version in package.json, package-lock.json and the Android build (versionName and versionCode). The pre-commit hook runs it automatically.
scripts-info.hooks:install: Points git to barberia-app/.githooks so the pre-commit hook bumps the version on every commit that touches the app.
scripts-info.prepare: Runs on npm install and installs the git hooks (same as hooks:install).
